note: Tool contract used by the agent and by the evaluator. Implementation: tools_reference.py. session.customer_id is the authenticated identity.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.returns: order, items, shipments, returns, customer (NOT ownership-checked)

tools.name: start_return
tools.returns: receipt; label emailed. Call only after eligibility is confirmed for the session customer's own order

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.returns: receipt. Call only after check_cancellation says can_cancel for the session customer's own order

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.returns: receipt. Sensitive: policy releases refunds only after a return is received, a cancellation, or a confirmed lost package

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.returns: receipt; specialist replies by email within 2 business days
